View and list evolution_management objects. Create/update/delete via object
create/update/delete.



Available subcommands:

- show: Display an evolution management by ID or the first

- list: List evolution_management objects with optional filters

  Show first evolution management
  zqk object evoman show
  Show by ID
  zqk object evoman show EVOL-001
  List all evolution management
  zqk object evoman list

Usage:
  zqk object evoman [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List evolution management objects
  show        Show an evolution management by ID or the first

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk object evoman [command] --help" for more information about a command.
